payload.body:
examiner (run-4, task 4): writing tests/enrollment.test.ts as eight described blocks, one per Proof leg (a)-(h), each test name carrying its leg letter and Machine clause.

Readings I am fixing so a later session does not have to re-derive them:

- Leg (a) five-argument call: kept as an uncalled, type-checked helper function body behind a single `// @ts-expect-error`, not as a live call. The leg asks that `bunx tsc --noEmit` prove the sixth parameter required; executing a five-argument `joinMember` at runtime would only prove that a missing `ids` throws, which is not what M1 pins. The helper is referenced by an assertion so it cannot be dropped as dead code.
- Leg (d) excess-property call: this one IS called at runtime, because the leg says it 'at runtime still returns true'. The `// @ts-expect-error` sits directly above the `partnerNotYet: true` property line, which is where TypeScript reports the excess-property error for an inline object literal argument.
- DEFAULT_MASK_LITERAL is checked against a locally constructed expected string (hours 9..20 of each day set, per Context), in addition to the leg's four properties (168 chars, 84 ones, index 9 is '1', index 8 is '0'). The exam does not import Task 1's DEFAULT_MASK: Context says this task does not consume Task 1, and Task 13 is where the two are asserted equal.
- Leg (b) calls `joinMember(pausedRow, {}, ...)` with no timezone and expects no throw: M1's timezone requirement is the fresh-join path only (existing === null).
- Leg (e) uses a `needsAck: false` input row for both the silent and non-silent cases, which is what the leg describes; M5's 'leaves it false otherwise' is not stretched into a claim about closing a non-silent pairing on an already-needsAck row.
- 'changes only X' legs are encoded as deep-equality of the whole row with X overridden, which is Context's 'all fields not named as changing are copied through unchanged'.

Expected at BASE: red because src/core/enrollment.ts does not exist.

payload.author: impl:4@run-4
payload.body: Task 4: implementing src/core/enrollment.ts as pure row transforms over MemberRow from src/types.ts. DEFAULT_MASK_LITERAL is written out as a 168-char literal in this file (hours 9-20 of each day set, 84 ones) so the module consumes nothing from Task 1. joinMember branches on existing: null builds the fresh row and requires opts.timezone (throws an Error naming timezone), a paused row goes through the same resume path as resumeMember so the two deep-equal, an active row only takes the given options. eligibleAt on the resume path is max(now, lastPairingAt + cadence), now when lastPairingAt is null; closePairing never touches eligibleAt. Fields not named as changing are copied through, including checkinSentAt, overlapNoticeAt, welcome and lastWelcomeAt.

payload.author: impl:4@run-4
payload.body: Task 4 done and committed. src/core/enrollment.ts implements all twelve Produces; the full suite is green (bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test: 266 pass, 0 fail) and the three grep guards pass. Decisions a later session would otherwise rediscover: (1) DEFAULT_MASK_LITERAL is verified equal to DEFAULT_MASK from src/core/availability.ts at runtime, which is what Task 13 asserts. (2) joinMember keeps the existing row's guildId and id when a row is passed, so the paused-row join deep-equals resumeMember, which takes no ids. (3) ids is required with no default, and joinMember also throws at runtime if it is missing so an untyped five-argument call gets a named Error rather than a bare TypeError; the type still refuses five arguments, which is what the exam pins behind ts-expect-error. (4) Fields not named as changing are copied through, including checkinSentAt on the resume and auto-pause paths, per the task's Context line. (5) expireCheckin treats any new ignored count of 2 or more as auto-paused, so a count already past 2 cannot fall back to resend.

payload.body:
examiner (run-4, task 4): tests/enrollment.test.ts is written and handed in. 31 tests, 109 assertions, one describe block per Proof leg (a)-(h); every test name carries its leg letter and Machine clause.

At BASE it is red for exactly one reason: `Cannot find module '../src/core/enrollment'`. No other failure, no missing fixture.

Satisfiability checked against a throwaway reference implementation written into src/core/enrollment.ts and then deleted (git status shows only tests/enrollment.test.ts added): all 31 pass and `bunx tsc --noEmit` is clean, so neither `@ts-expect-error` is a dead directive. Both were then confirmed to bite: giving `ids` a default of `{ guildId: '', id: '' }` (the exact defect run-2 and run-3 died on) and widening the evidence type with `partnerNotYet?: boolean` each produce TS2578 'Unused @ts-expect-error directive' at lines 103 and 305. So the type-level halves of M1 and M4 fail loudly under `bunx tsc --noEmit` rather than passing silently.

Leg coverage, as encoded:
(a) six-argument join: guildId, id, and the eight literal fields of M1, plus timezone; mask strictly equals DEFAULT_MASK_LITERAL; the literal is 168 chars, 84 ones, '1' at 9, '0' at 8, and equals a locally built 'hours 9..20 of each day' string; a no-timezone join throws an Error whose message contains 'timezone'; the five-argument call sits in an uncalled, type-checked function.
(b) joinMember and resumeMember on a paused row deep-equal each other; state/needsAck/checkinsIgnored; eligibleAt at all three of lastPairingAt+cadence > now, == now-1, and null; the five unchanged fields.
(c) timezone-only, avoid-only and pauseMember each asserted as whole-row deep-equality with one field overridden, plus an input-not-mutated check.
(d) all eight boolean combinations, exactly one silent; the excess-property call runs and returns true.
(e) closePairing both ways with eligibleAt pinned to the input's; recordEvidence differs in needsAck alone.
(f) sendCheckin and both answers. Note: for 'pause' the exam asserts state === 'paused' plus that mask, preset, timezone, avoid, joinedAt and eligibleAt are untouched, deliberately NOT full-row equality, because M6 names only state and an implementation that also clears checkinSentAt on a pause is not contradicting the clause. Whole-row equality is used where the clause names every changing field.
(g) all four expireCheckin branches, with the 'none' cases asserting the row comes back deep-equal to the input.
(h) the full inPool truth table, with eligibleAt === now as the true boundary case and now + 1 as the false one.

Nothing under unsatisfiable: every leg is encoded as written.
